description: This file contains utility functions for filtering superblocks, blocks, and challenges within a curriculum structure, as well as functions for fuzzy matching of superblock and block names.

methods.name: filterByBlock
methods.description: Filters the superblocks array to include at most one superblock with the specified block dashedName.

methods.name: filterBySuperblock
methods.description: Filters superblocks to include only those with specified name(s).

methods.name: filterByChallengeId
methods.description: Filters superblocks to include only challenges matching a specific challenge ID and their subsequent challenge.

methods.name: createFilterPipeline
methods.description: Creates a pipeline of filter functions to apply sequentially.

methods.name: applyFilters
methods.description: Applies a sequence of filters (superblock, block, challengeId) to data.

methods.name: closestMatch
methods.description: Finds the best fuzzy match for a target string within a list of strings.

methods.name: closestFilters
methods.description: Finds the closest matching superblock or block name based on fuzzy matching.
